title: Constrained Subsequence Sum
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, find the maximum sum of a non-empty subsequence where the difference between the indices of any two consecutive elements is at most k.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, find the maximum sum of a non-empty subsequence where the difference between the indices of any two consecutive elements is at most k.
constraints: Choose a non-empty subsequence whose consecutive chosen indices differ by at most k.
Return its maximum sum; values may be negative.
hints: Let best[i] be the best valid subsequence ending at i.
Add nums[i] to the positive maximum best value among the previous k indices, or start at nums[i].
Maintain candidate best values in decreasing order in a deque and expire old indices.
The deque front is exactly the window maximum needed by the recurrence.
